message: Dear Katie dub,

I love you so so so much. I had such an amazing time with you on our trip to Madeira and the Azores. My favorite was probably going up into the mountains of Madeira and seeing the clouds roll over the peaks. Every moment of this trip I have been so thankful to have you as my wife. Traveling is so much more fun when it is with someone you love and I feel so lucky that I get to make memories with you that I will have forever.

You are the kindest, most loving, beautiful, funny, and perfect person I have ever met. I so appreciate all the work you have put in to become the best person you can be. You have worked and are working so hard to set our family down the right path. I look at you and I see my past, present, and future. It’s hard to believe that we’ve already been together for almost 7 years! The time I’ve spent with you is the best of my life and you’ve added to my life in uncountable ways.

You have been the most overcome wife anyone could ask for and I get so excited to see what our future has in store for us. I can’t wait to raise kids in the mountains with you. Seeing you on this trip I know that you will make such an amazing mom. I can’t wait to take the whole family camping on the Poudre River or in the Tetons or in RMNP and have you by my side. Imagine how cute it will be to have old Sunny, lily, and Layla jumping in creeks getting all muddy.

As excited as I am to live the future with you I am also so excited to live this current season with you. I think CSU will be such an amazing place for you and I am so excited to see make new friends and learn new things. I love seeing how passionate you are about taking care of elderly people that many forget about and I know that you will make such an amazing OT because of you passion to care for others and ensure that they are respected and maintain dignity.
You are truly the most amazing person I have ever met. I love you more than I thought it was possible to love another person. You are the light of my life and I couldn’t imagine my life without you.
Yours always and forever,
Ben
Hey dub.... I love you super duper  -your bo
Benjamin,

You are taking a big ole nap right now and I figure it’s the perfect time to write you a little note. I love you more than words will ever be able to express. The thing is, that statement is really cheesy, so I am going to try to do explain it in a different way. Although these words will never be truly enough, they are a start. I love how you care so completely about the people you love. Yeah, you mess, but that is only because you first love. You have a heart that is wide open and that’s something that many people strive to achieve. You are a safe haven in the midst of chaos and a little extra spice on a bland day. When you wrap me in your arms I know with 100% certainty that I am loved, safe, valued, known, and cherished. I love the smallest parts about you. I am so blessed to be able to watch as wheels of thought turn in your brain and when your fingers fiddle with just about any object they can find. I love that you always make sure I have access to cold fun water (even at the expense of your own glass). I love how you find random objects and deconstruct them just because you are curious about them. I love the way you question things and seek knowledge. I love how you have a whole separate world full of action and philosophies and random memories constructed in your head. I love how you smile so fully right after you get spooked and that sweet, goofy hug that always comes right after. I love the way you breathe in your sleep and that very silly face you make when you are about to sneeze. I love that you are convinced that you didn’t burp before a year ago even though you for sure did. I love a million things about you. I know that this little note is probably just putting a magnifying glass on one grain of sand that composes the Cape Cod sized dune that is me loving and cherishing you forever but I hope you find it to be a good reminder of what is true in your life.
Bo,

Today is the day I had to come home from spending the best time ever with you. You made this summer fantastic so far and you probably don’t even realize it. I can’t thank you enough for always being a safe haven for me, a shoulder to cry on, a friend to laugh with, and so much more. You are the person who makes me whole. The guy I can be myself with and I know you are seeing me with a heart posture of love rather than judgement. I can’t wait to spend many more hours, weeks, days, and years being authentic and vulnerable with you. I love you infinitely. Always and forever yours, Dub 😘
Ben,

My love for you goes far over the moon and every star. You are an incredible person and without a doubt the man I have been praying for. Your existence and giving me a chance make me the luckiest woman in the world. Today I was reminded of how much you teach me about listening to others and showing love through silence. I sooo appreciate that I have the opportunity to learn from you daily and I am looking forward to admiring these aspects of who you are for years to come. I love you forever and I am very appreciative of you always being here to listen to me when I am talkative.
Bo,
No matter what, I love you endlessly. You are spectacular and very very loved!
Our vows

Hey! I know you! You are the love of my life. I am on a work trip right now and just sitting here missing you at the same time. I so so so appreciate the love and support you show for me following my callings and passions with work- even though it means I am doing something unusual and not making a ton of money. It means the world to be with someone who fully supports me in this way. I love you and I can’t wait to see you when I get back!!!   - Dubs
Our vows:
I promise to daily love and persue you. I promise to have the same mindset as Christ towards you: to love you unconditionally,  forgive you always, and to never leave you until death do we part.

HAAPY HAPPY ANIVERSERAY! As of like 4 minutes ago (which was 7:30 am EST) we have been married for 3 years! I feel so incredibly  lucky to have been able to spend that time with you as your husband. For practically my entire adult life I have had you by my side  and I am so so so thankful for that. I love getting to wake you up in the mornings (which I'll get to do in about 45 min) because  you are always so sleepy and cute and often happy to see me. I love long car rides where I listen to yap about everything that comes  to mind. I love hiking with you even when its hard and you get frustrated - but because I am proud of you and I enjoy spending time  with you outside. I love cuddling up on the couch and watching twin peaks, survivor, criterion movies, or whatever else we are binging.  I love yapping to YOU about my favorite movies. I love playing with sunny together - I am so glad we added her to our family. And   most of all I simply LOVE YOU!! I am so thankful for 3 years and I can't wait for the next 3, 5, 10, 50 years!!
Love,  BO

It has been a long time since I have updated this page, so I decided to finally publish it so that you will always have access.  I love you so immensly Katie. Since my last update we have traveled to Colorado Springs to have christmas with everyone, took   a cruise to the bahamas with my parents, done quite a few hikes, and so much more. Oh also you knit like three sweaters which   is AWESOME! I am so thankful to have you always by my side. You are the most important person to and I am so excited to continue spending my life with you.
This weekend we are going to go to Buffalo Wild Wings for a birthday celebration then on saturday we are going to go to see   Project Hail Mary in IMAX. I cant wait! I love you! - Bo

To the love of my life, you bring a psark to my life that I am so eternally thankful for. I love you for you goofy antics and for the way that you  look at me that makes it so clear that I am loved. Cheers to spending forever together. Always and Forever, Bo

Hi Love Bug, I am so thrilled to be your husband. Everyday that I get to spend with you is a blessing that I would not trade anything for. You make the  mundane so fun and exciting. I can't help but feel the most overwhelming feeling of love whenever I spend time with. Thank you for being the light of my  life and don't ever forget just how much you mean to me. Love, Bo.

Hello beautiful. I think you are simply the most amazing wife. I am so thankful to have you in my life. Right now you are making me a yummy coffee.   Then what you don’t know is that I will suggest watching survivor. You mean so so so much to me. On hard days at work you make me feel so much better.   Having you is like having someone built into my life on such a fundamental level that I can always rely on you to cheer me up just by you being you.   You are the most amazing cute beautiful funny silly fun and passionate wife that a guy could ask for. I send lots of love through the internet so that   you may feel just an ounce of the love I feel from you. ♥️♥️♥️

Hi Katie dub, I love you so much. It is due time for me to post an update on the countup. It has been a long time since the last post here, much too LONG.  Since last time so much has happened. We traveled to destin to visit with the Shroffs and Arlene. Then we had our january in Loveland with some fun hikes  (remember garden of the gods!?), then we went to Breckenridge for me to ski with my Dad some. Through all of this you have been working so hard on your classes. I have  been so proud of how you have been approaching your classes. You are doing both physiology and anatomy (plus two others!) sheesh! It sounds so tough but you  have been doing such a great job taking on the new challenge. I love you so much and every day that I get to spend to with you is such a blessing. Just this  last weekend we had the best time just hanging out. We didn't do anything special but goofin off and playing a game made last weekend the best ever. I love  you enormously and I hope you never forget just how much you mean to me.

Breckenridge We made it down to Breckenridge this February to do some skiing. My mom and dad flew in an I had the opportunity to ski with my dad some. I was   thankful for the opportunity and thankful for you for how supportive you are when it comes to my dad. I know that its difficult and its a hard journey for every one  but your compassion, care, and willingness to engage is super appreciated.

Colorado in the Winter We have already got to do some fun things this winter. We finally made it to Garden of the Gods, hiked in Eldorado Canyon, I summitted  Sheep Mountain for the first time. Moving to colorado was such a good decision for us and I am so glad that we get to enjoy being outside here. The weather is  sometimes crazy but its perfect for us. The 65 degree days last week were so fun and I can't wait to have some more snow filled fun before winter is over.

images.label: Me and Sunny at Eldrorado Canyon

message: Destin This year we went to Destin, FL to visit with my Grandma, Avery, Chelsey, Rory, Lindsey, Beth, Jerry, John, Zack, Sam, my mom, and my dad. It was  a lot of people but I was glad to be able to spend that time with you as well. It is so special that we get to live our lives together and get to approach these  types of events and trips as a unified married couple. I love living life married to you and I feel so blessed to get to do it every day.

2001: A Space Odyssey The Discovery One Replica For christmas this year we discovered a new skill of yours. Turns out you are very talented at putting  together model replicas of space ships from classic science fiction movies. I had such a good time. Making this model with you while we goofed off and yapped.  Thanks for being my best friend and always being down to do something like this when you I want to. I love you

Love O' Love, It is December 2024 and we are getting ready to travel with my family to visit in Destin Florida over Christmas. This marks the sixth  (SIXTH!) Chrstmas we have spent together. That is so exciting to me. Over the past couple weeks we took Sunny on a fun new hike near Crater  Carter lake, I was forced to travel back to Chapel Hill for a few days for meetings, and then we made a brisket. The best part of all of these things  was having you as my wife as they happened. I am so eternally excited to wake up everyday and be surrounded by your love. This season of our life can   be difficult with the uncertainity surrounding school and big life decisions we are making together but there is no place I would rather be than here with you.  We are currently living the life we always hoped we would we. Surrounded by the beauty of the mountains with our puppy dog. I love you so so much and when  I think of where we were five years ago it only makes me all the more excited to see where we will be five years from now. Always and Forever, Ben

images.label: They forced me to go to a hockey game

message: Hi Katie Love, I love you so much. Last week was pretty crazy. Last wednesday we woke up verrrry early to drive to the airport. We got there  and nearly all the parking spots were taken so we had to park on the top level of the garage as snow was starting to come down hard. We got through  security, made our way to our gate, and boarded our plane only to have to wait 3 hours on the tarmac, yuck. Then we flew to RDU where Taylor picked  us up and drove us to Leland. We spent some time there before coming home and seeing my parents, for the weekend. Then you drove them to the airport  on Monday and we finally had some quiet time. There is no body I would rather have by my side than you during the holidays. You are the cutest, kindest,  funniest, and best wife I could ever ask for and I feel so lucky to have you. Right now, you are cooking us dinner and soon we will watch a movie. I  feel so blessed to have you in my life. I love you always and forever, Bo.

Hi Katie Love Bug dub, SORRY! It’s been a minute since I’ve updated this, but I am popping in to let you know how loved and cherished you are.  This past month has been full of some great outdoor adventures and quality time. you are my best friend, and I feel so lucky to be able to do things  like get our Melanzanas together. You are the light of my world, and I can’t wait to keep on keepin on. Every day when I come wake you up around  6:45 I think about how amazing it is to have you as my wife. You are the cutest, most amazingly awesome wife I could ever hope to ask for.   Thanks for being the love of my life. Love, Ben
Leadville, November 2024

Katie, I feel so honored to have you as my wife. You constantly make my days better and put a smile on my face. You are almost always the best part of my day and you contribute so much to make   me feel loved and valued. You are the best wife I could possibly ask for and I love you completly and endlessy. Sometimes things can be difficult and feel defeating but there is no one I would   face those challenges than with you. You are such a gift to my life and I feel incredibly lucky to have you as my partner and I am so excited to see what our future has in store for us. We   have come so far since we started dating 5 (FIVE!) years ago. Who knew that we would be married with the cutest puppy living in Colorado. Life was so hard and and the life we are living now   felt so distant but we stuck with it and now we are here. Imagine what life will be like in another 5 years. You are the light of my life Katie and I can't wait to grow old with you and spend  my life with you. I love you, Always and Forever, Ben

Hi Love Bug, we are wrapping up our visit to Albuqurque and will be headed back to Loveland soon. I love you so much and I appreciate all the effort you put into going with the flow this weekend.  I had so much fun at all the Balloons related events we went to even if it meant we couldn't get quite as much sleep as hoped for. You are the love of my life and it is so special to me to be  able to take trips like this with you. I have so thankful to have you as my forever travel partner. ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️ -Ben

Goooooood Morrrrrrnnning Katie Dub, Every day I love my morning routine. I wake up at 5 and then immediately take Sunny out, bring her inside, then feed her. After Sunny is taken care of  I make my yummy cortado. It usually says 5:12 on the oven clock by then, but don't be tricked because its actually about 5:14 once I've finished making my coffee. Next, I sit down and drink  my cortado while reading or watching tv. More recently I've been choosing to either read the economist or a book I'm working on. At about 6 I relocated upstairs to my desk. I turn on my slack  and most of the time get started on my work (sometimes I keep reading). Either way, the best part of the morning comes next, around 6:50am, when I come to the room to check on you and wake you up  if you're not awake yet. You are the most beautiful person I have ever met and I am so lucky to have you waiting for me every morning in our room looking as cute as you. You are my favorite part  of every day and I love you so so so so much. -Ben

Katie, today was a no good day. I put in sick from work and just did not feel myself. However, despite that I felt so lucky to have you as my wife. I love you so much  and I'm so thankful to have you on my team. Love, Ben
Happy Birthday!! Happy Birthday!!

Hi Love, right now you are observing OT at theraswim. I'm so proud of you and the work you are putting in for this application. Sunny and I have been sitting here reflecting on how important you  are to us and how we love you so very much. I can't wait for you to get back to hear about how to went. As always, I love you enormously, -Ben

Hi Katie, Today we went to Redeemer Lutheran for the first time. They had In n Out food trucks there although we didn't partake. I think the experience there was a little bit better than  we were expecting but we are still hoping to find more people our age for community. After church we can home, watched Lost, and made a pot roasts. Its days like today where I am so grateful to have you as my wife.  Looking for churches, cooking dinner, or binging tv shows there is no one I would rather be with than you. You light up my world and I can wait to grow old with you. I love you, always and forever, Ben

Love Bug, I just had the most incredible time running errands with you, despite feeling a little anxious at the store. One of the many joys of being married to you is that I always have  someone to make mundane things fun. Love, Ben

Hi Katie, today is a day that I love you so so so much. I constantly am thinking about how grateful and happy I am to have you in my life. Katie love, you are the light of my life  and every day that I get to spend married to you is a blessing. I thank God for you, that I get to have a wife like you to spend my life with. I am so so so excited for our future together. I love you, -bo

DUB, I remind you now how absolutely amazing you are. The dedication and effort you are putting into everything you are doing is great to watch, and I  couldn’t be more proud of you. You face every challenge wit strength and determination, and it makes me love and admire you even more. I believe in you completely, and I’m so lucky to have you with me
Hi Love Bug, I love you so eternally much. I am forever grateful to have you as my wife and I think about you constantly.  You make all the hard work worth it and I feel like the luckiest man alive.
